_comment: Unified prompt-router config (v3, 2026-09-27). The router evaluates the ENTIRE trigger floor at runtime (classify.py::_floor_index) with word-boundary matching, then ranks <= max_skill_pushes skills above min_skill_score by surface (FE/BE/API/docs from prompt paths + vocab, cwd, repo stack), intent, and the curated category lists. consumes_entire_floor=true is what build-trigger-floor.py --check verifies. Router-only tuning lives under 'additions' — never edit the floor by hand.
_tail_comment: A-08 (2026-10-31): ranks 1-3 need min_skill_score, ranks 4-5 only min_skill_score_tail. The user's priority is recall, not tokens; router_replay.py recall signals measure it.
_deep_inject_comment: FIX-r3 T7: 0 = never inline a skill body; the rank-1 MUST-READ line names the skill and its ACTION: Read path. Set e.g. 600 to inline the rank-1 body again (capped, rank-1 only, deep_inject_ratio x rank 2).
_caps_comment: max_route_lines caps the /invoke dispatch lines, max_mcp_routes the MCP lines; max_routing_lines is the one total cap on the [Suggested routing] section (model-mode echo first, then UI, MCP, dispatch). enforce_hard: a rank-1 push is recorded enforce:'hard' for invoke-suite-gate only at score >= min_score, >= margin x rank 2, with an index intent/strong-surface match; else 'soft' (prompt_router/policy.py).

priority_tiers.0: gate-adjacent — first-write baseline, TDD (backend surface / TEST intent only)
priority_tiers.1: substrate precedence (jcodemunch for code, jdocmunch for docs, graphify for architecture) + indexed symbols + at most ONE deep-injected skill body
priority_tiers.2: ranked skill pushes: rank 1 MUST-READ (none when its body is inlined), ranks 2-4 SHOULD-READ; aliases collapsed; core-skill-set skills never re-pushed; surface pointer, WORKFLOW and LIBRARY routing lines
priority_tiers.3: routing (UI signal, MCP routes, /invoke act or specialist dispatch, per-project model mode) + model advice

dedup.invariant: suppresses verbatim re-injection only; never suppresses a first fire

additions._comment: Router-only trigger ADDITIONS atop the floor. intents: extra act keywords per category (same <=3-char rule as the floor). surface_skills: surface/tag -> {skill: boost}; a boost from a stack-only inference is multiplied by weak_surface_factor. skill_rules: regex (on the lower-cased prompt) -> skill boost, optionally gated on surfaces. Plugin skills use the plugin:skill name; every candidate must exist on disk (local skill dir or installed plugin) or it is dropped.
additions._model_routing_weak_comment: REVIEW2 Fix 1: bare model / plan-size tokens. One alone is the 'use opus for this' override phrase, not model-routing talk; MODEL_ROUTING fires on an intents.MODEL_ROUTING keyword or on >= 2 distinct weak hits (classify.py).

ui_veto._comment: R3.6: these words score UI only with a UI noun within `window` words; with a MODEL_ROUTING hit they never score UI or DESIGN unless a noun is near, and with no UI noun anywhere the frontend surfaces are dropped (classify.py).

stack_indicators._comment: ECC project-stack-mappings.json (config/, @25278e7d) reduced to router tags. `file` is a glob on the marker NAME, `contains` a case-insensitive substring of its body (first 64 KB); a stack's tag attaches when any indicator matches. side backend/frontend also adds that surface; any/mobile tag only. Scanned by surface._scan within 3 levels, cached in state/<repo>.stack.json (sig _v 5). A backend-side marker under android/ or ios/, or next to an RN package.json / pubspec.yaml, is skipped (surface._mobile_shell). Stack tags are weak unless the prompt names them; backend/frontend-side tags attach only when that side is in play.

stacks._side_comment: any, not backend: a requirements.txt next to a helper script is not a service (surface.py keeps the _PY_BE web-framework rule for that)
any, not backend (REVIEW2 Fix 2): every RN / Flutter / Android app has android/build.gradle; springboot carries the backend side
any, not backend: Android apps are Kotlin (REVIEW2 Fix 2)
any, not backend: a stock RN app ships a root Gemfile for CocoaPods (REVIEW2 Fix 2)

stacks._comment: A-07: stack-skill tags (mongoose-patterns, fastify-patterns, vitest-rtl); weak until the prompt names them or its side is established

package_managers._comment: package.json packageManager field wins, then the first lockfile found, root first (ECC scripts/lib/package-manager.js order). Exposed as tag pm:<name>.

surface_pointers._comment: ROUTING pointer lines per surface (files, not skills). Fires once per session (manifest id route:pointer:<surface>) when the surface is present and, if `intents` is set, one of them hit.

claude-infra.text: Model routing → the single truth is hooks/model-policy.json (opus-guard and workflow-model-guard enforce it); read rules/04-model-routing.md and docs/MODEL-ROUTING.md before changing tiers, pins or the task matrix.

egm._comment: Elephant-Goldfish Model (plugin egm@egm): design-doc review/brainstorm/draft/drift route (modules/egm_routes.py). The plugin's skills are disable-model-invocation, so the line tells the model to Read the SKILL.md under the resolved plugin root; Santa Method stays the reviewer for code diffs. question_rx applies even with an explicit cue ("what is the elephant goldfish model?" is a question, not a review).

routes.rx: \b(brainstorm\w*|design decisions?|how should we (design|architect|structure|model)|design (a|an|the) (new )?(system|service|architecture|api|pipeline|protocol|data model|schema|feature|flow)|before (we|i) (write|build) any code|no code yet)\b

text.egm-review: EGM Goldfish review of a design doc (Santa stays for code diffs): Read {md} and follow it in this thread; ${{CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}} = {root} (the Skill tool refuses egm skills). EGM artifact directory: {art}
text.egm-brainstorm: Design decisions first → EGM brainstorm (build only after the user approves the design): Read {md} and follow it here; ${{CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}} = {root}; no Skill tool for egm. EGM artifact directory: {art}
text.egm-draft: EGM draft: Read {md} and follow it here; ${{CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}} = {root}; no Skill tool for egm. EGM artifact directory: {art}
text.egm-drift-report: EGM drift report (design docs vs code, report only): Read {md} and follow it here; ${{CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}} = {root}; no Skill tool for egm. EGM artifact directory: {art}

additions._builtin_skills_comment: Harness skills with no skills/ directory (callable through the Skill tool): select.skill_exists accepts them, the push line is Skill("name"). A-06.

demote._comment: Process/meta skills multiply by this factor (clamped to <= 1.0: never a boost) before the score floor: they are doctrine (CLAUDE.md, core-skill-set) rather than surface skills, and without a demotion they take 2 of the 4 slots on every build prompt. A strong intent signal (PLAN/SPEC/DEBUG category boost) still lifts them over the floor. `dox-doc-tree` 0.7 is the only value the retired `skill_router_weights.json` carried; it is a core skill and never ranks, kept for the record.
